title: Dating his Paramount time against Boris Morros and the Raeburn records
summary: They try to fix dates, Handy conducted the Jubilee date while Ike Carpenter played piano.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Did I ask you if Boris Morris was the movie director then?
That was before or after Boris--that was before Boris I guess?
I don't know. I would think it was after, because I remember hearing his name kicked around then. When was he there?
I'm not sure I put a date on that. When "Tales of Manhattan" was
produced he was there I know. He was a double agent; he was there during the war, because he was a double agent during the war, at some point.
I think he was there before I was there. It would have had to have been before '45.
It was before. You're on the roster on the band in December of '44 on these records.
No, I'm sorry, you were on the band May, 1944 and then in December 1944 Ike Carpenter was on the band. Ike Carpenter played piano on that V disc, on your music.
Right, it would have to be, it would have to be another pianist, because I conducted. I was standing in front of the band on that Jubilee date.
